HealthLedger
EHR Access Control & FL
Decentralized EHR & Federated Learning

Sovereign Medical Records with On-Chain Access Control

Zero-Knowledge client-side AES-256 encryption, decentralized IPFS storage, and an immutable Ethereum access-control layer with patient-driven Federated Learning consent.

Client-Side Web Crypto

Medical files are encrypted with symmetric AES-GCM-256 in browser memory before IPFS transmission. Storage nodes never receive plaintext health data.

IPFS & bytes32 Multihash

IPFS CIDv0 hashes are converted into gas-efficient 32-byte words (bytes32) stored on Ethereum for $O(1)$ constant-gas lookups.

Federated Learning Consent

Patients can toggle the flEligible flag to participate in privacy-preserving clinical AI model training without centralizing sensitive data.

HealthLedger • Final Year Engineering Project • Solidity 0.8.24 + Web Crypto AES-256 + IPFS
